<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':39,'col':39},
              {'action':'MOUSE','row':47,'col':55},
              {'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':39}], intent='explore')
print("result:", {k:v for k,v in res.items() if k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
cur = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def norm(ch): return 'R' if ch in 'RW' else 'b'
def board_state(r0,c0,lines):
    out=[]
    for i in range(3):
        row=[]
        for j in range(3):
            row.append(norm(lines[r0+8*i+3][c0+8*j+3]) if (i,j)!=(1,1) else norm(lines[r0+11][c0+11]))
        out.append(row)
    return out
def pattern(r0,c0,lines):
    m=[''.join(lines[r0+8+i][c0+8:c0+14]) for i in range(6)]
    return [''.join(norm(m[r][c]) for c in (0,2,4)) for r in (0,2,4)]
for name,(r0,c0) in [('TL',(2,4)),('TR',(2,38)),('BL',(36,4)),('BR',(36,36))]:
    st=board_state(r0,c0,cur); pat=pattern(r0,c0,cur)
    mism=[(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if st[i][j]!=pat[i][j]]
    print(name,'state',st,'pattern',pat,'mismatches',mism)
print("level:", current_frame.level, "step:", current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
